metric_definitions.pr_auc: Average precision, a summary of the precision-recall curve; reported as PR-AUC.

metadata.preprocessing: Type one-hot encoding and sensor standardization; both transformers fit on training rows only. IDs and failure-mode labels are excluded.
metadata.imbalance_note: Machine failure is the minority class. Accuracy alone can hide missed failures, so precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC and the confusion matrix are reported. Models use fixed settings without resampling or test-set threshold tuning.

permutation_importance.evaluation_partition: held-out test set; post-hoc explanation only
permutation_importance.type_grouping: all Type one-hot columns permuted together
